title: Ballot record, version 2 (naming its cell): encodings, admission checks and decode rejections
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-v2-vectors.py, an implementation of the Ballot record (version 2) section with Python's integers and hashlib, reusing this folder's independent ballot, ballot-validity, membership, revoting, tier-tree and regional-cells generators; cell trees built here from each tier's groups by the first-occurrence rule; membership proofs by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-proofs.mjs, run outside the workspace with Semaphore 4.14.3's depth-32 circuit artifacts and snarkjs 0.7.5's fullProve, which checks that each proof's outputs equal the root and nullifier computed here; every pairing verdict is snarkjs's groth16.verify on the signals derived here from the record and the definition. Decode errors and their offsets are labelled by hand from the strict-decoding rules and the layout's fixed offsets
